package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * What a cardio workout is done on (KAN-936 design §9, §11): the [kinds] a workout of it may be
 * labelled with, in §9's order with Custom last, and the target [metrics] its steps may carry —
 * both the backend's `CardioActivity` sets verbatim. [label] is the picker's name, [withArticle] the
 * form the shorthand's error copy reads ("incline isn't a target on an outdoor run").
 */
@Serializable
enum class CardioActivity(
    val label: String,
    val withArticle: String,
    val kinds: List<CardioKind>,
    val metrics: Set<CardioMetric>,
) {
    OUTDOOR_RUN(
        "Outdoor run",
        "an outdoor run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE, CardioMetric.CADENCE),
    ),
    TREADMILL_RUN(
        "Treadmill run",
        "a treadmill run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    OUTDOOR_RIDE(
        "Outdoor ride",
        "an outdoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    INDOOR_RIDE(
        "Indoor ride",
        "an indoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ELLIPTICAL(
        "Elliptical",
        "an elliptical",
        listOf(CardioKind.STEADY, CardioKind.INTERVALS, CardioKind.HILLS, CardioKind.CUSTOM),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),

    /** Metric whatever the workout's unit: pace per 500 m, every distance in metres (KAN-936 `rower-is-metric`). */
    ROWER(
        "Rower",
        "a rower",
        listOf(
            CardioKind.STEADY_STATE,
            CardioKind.INTERVALS,
            CardioKind.PYRAMID,
            CardioKind.SPRINTS,
            CardioKind.TEST_2K,
            CardioKind.CUSTOM,
        ),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ;

    val isRide: Boolean get() = this == OUTDOOR_RIDE || this == INDOOR_RIDE
}

private fun runKinds() =
    listOf(
        CardioKind.EASY,
        CardioKind.RECOVERY,
        CardioKind.LONG,
        CardioKind.TEMPO,
        CardioKind.INTERVALS,
        CardioKind.FARTLEK,
        CardioKind.HILLS,
        CardioKind.PROGRESSION,
        CardioKind.RACE,
        CardioKind.CUSTOM,
    )

package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import com.gymie.shared.domain.InstantIso8601Serializer

import com.gymie.shared.domain.WorkoutStatus
import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate

import kotlinx.datetime.serializers.LocalDateIso8601Serializer
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.time.Instant

@Serializable
data class CardioDistance(
    val value: Double,
    val unit: DistanceUnit,
)

/** A number or a range; a single value is `min == max` (KAN-936 `targets-are-plain-numbers`). */
data class CardioTarget(
    val metric: CardioMetric,
    val min: Double,
    val max: Double,
)

sealed interface CardioLength {
    data class Time(
        val seconds: Int,
    ) : CardioLength

    data class Of(
        val distance: CardioDistance,
    ) : CardioLength

    data object Open : CardioLength
}

/** A plan's step tree (decision `sealed-step-tree`); the wire's flat shape is [CardioStepWire]. */
sealed interface CardioStep {
    val note: String?

    data class Interval(
        val type: CardioStepType,
        val length: CardioLength,
        val targets: List<CardioTarget> = emptyList(),
        override val note: String? = null,
    ) : CardioStep

    /** One repeat level: [steps] are intervals only (KAN-936 `one-repeat-level`). */
    data class Repeat(
        val count: Int,
        val steps: List<Interval>,
        override val note: String? = null,
    ) : CardioStep
}

/** Mirrors `CardioLogResponse`: the session totals, plus pace and speed derived when not typed. */
@Serializable
data class CardioLog(
    val durationSeconds: Int,
    val distance: CardioDistance? = null,
    val avgPaceSeconds: Int? = null,
    val avgSpeed: Double? = null,
    val avgHeartRate: Int? = null,
    val maxHeartRate: Int? = null,
    val calories: Int? = null,
    val effort: Int? = null,
    val elevationGain: Int? = null,
    val avgCadence: Int? = null,
    val avgPower: Int? = null,
    val derivedAvgPaceSeconds: Int? = null,
    val derivedAvgSpeed: Double? = null,
)

/** Mirrors `PreviousCardioResponse` — "last time", read by `CardioApi.lastCardio`. */
@Serializable
data class PreviousCardio(
    @Serializable(with = LocalDateIso8601Serializer::class)
    val performedOn: LocalDate,
    val log: CardioLog,
)

/** Mirrors `CardioWorkoutResponse`; [steps] map to the tree through [toPlan]. */
@Serializable
data class CardioWorkout(
    val id: String,
    @Serializable(with = LocalDateIso8601Serializer::class)
    val scheduledDate: LocalDate,
    @Serializable(with = LocalTimeHourMinuteSerializer::class)
    val scheduledTime: LocalTime? = null,
    val name: String? = null,
    val displayName: String,
    val notes: String? = null,
    val status: WorkoutStatus,
    @Serializable(with = InstantIso8601Serializer::class)
    val startedAt: Instant? = null,
    @Serializable(with = InstantIso8601Serializer::class)
    val finishedAt: Instant? = null,
    val activity: CardioActivity,
    val kind: CardioKind,
    val distanceUnit: DistanceUnit,
    val steps: List<CardioStepWire> = emptyList(),
    val log: CardioLog? = null,
    val owner: CardioOwner? = null,
)

/** Mirrors `CardioOwnerResponse`: on a read only when the acting user is not the owner (a switched-in session). */
@Serializable
data class CardioOwner(
    val userId: String,
    val displayName: String,
    val avatarUrl: String? = null,
    val gender: String? = null,
)

/**
 * Mirrors `CardioWorkoutSummaryResponse` (the range list) and `WeekCardioSummaryResponse` (a week
 * day's and an owner group's `cardio[]`, KAN-936) — the two carry the same fields.
 */
@Serializable
data class CardioWorkoutSummary(
    val id: String,
    @Serializable(with = LocalDateIso8601Serializer::class)
    val scheduledDate: LocalDate,
    @Serializable(with = LocalTimeHourMinuteSerializer::class)
    val scheduledTime: LocalTime? = null,
    val name: String? = null,
    val displayName: String,
    val status: WorkoutStatus,
    @Serializable(with = InstantIso8601Serializer::class)
    val startedAt: Instant? = null,
    @Serializable(with = InstantIso8601Serializer::class)
    val finishedAt: Instant? = null,
    val activity: CardioActivity,
    val kind: CardioKind,
    val distanceUnit: DistanceUnit,
    val plannedSeconds: Int = 0,
    val plannedMeters: Long = 0,
    val hasOpenSteps: Boolean = false,
    val loggedSeconds: Int? = null,
    val loggedDistance: CardioDistance? = null,
)

/** The body of `POST` (create, a client [id] makes it replay-safe) and `PUT /api/cardio-workouts/{id}`. */
@Serializable
data class CardioDraft(
    @Serializable(with = LocalDateIso8601Serializer::class)
    val scheduledDate: LocalDate,
    @Serializable(with = LocalTimeHourMinuteSerializer::class)
    val scheduledTime: LocalTime? = null,
    val name: String? = null,
    val notes: String? = null,
    val activity: CardioActivity,
    val kind: CardioKind,
    val steps: List<CardioStepWire> = emptyList(),
    val id: String? = null,

/** Mirrors `CardioLogRequest`; `clientAt` is the API's to stamp (`CardioApi.logCardio`). */
@Serializable
data class CardioLogRequest(
    val durationSeconds: Int,
    val distance: CardioDistance? = null,

    val avgSpeed: Double? = null,
    val avgHeartRate: Int? = null,
    val maxHeartRate: Int? = null,
    val calories: Int? = null,
    val effort: Int? = null,
    val elevationGain: Int? = null,
    val avgCadence: Int? = null,
    val avgPower: Int? = null,
    val clientAt: String? = null,
)

/** Mirrors `CopyCardioWorkoutRequest`; a client [id] makes it replay-safe. */
@Serializable
data class CopyCardioWorkoutRequest(
    @Serializable(with = LocalDateIso8601Serializer::class)
    val targetDate: LocalDate,
    @Serializable(with = LocalTimeHourMinuteSerializer::class)
    val scheduledTime: LocalTime? = null,
    val id: String? = null,
)
